name: gaps
note: Fourteen days with no rain at all, of which only nine count. Two of them sit exactly on the coverage floor of FR-048 — 18 of 24 intervals is 75 per cent, and the comparison is inclusive, so they are measured; two sit one interval below it and are not. Three more have full intervals and only two operators, which FR-010 leaves without a value however dry the sky was. The point of the fixture is that a dry sky is not a dry day: silence breaks the run, and the run this scenario pays for is five days rather than fourteen.
